Result schema version & path.question: Where should result.v2.schema.json live in the tree?
What counts as a backwards-incompatible (major) schema change?
Result schema version & path.answer: Strict additive-only is minor; everything else is major. Adding optional fields / new enum values for forward-compat consumers = v2.x. Renaming, removing, narrowing types, changing nullability, repurposing = v3.
options_presented: Looser (also allow new required fields as minor)

Result schema version & path.question: How should the schema version surface inside each result.v2.json file?
Result schema version & path.answer: Single `schema_version: "v2"` string field at the top of the JSON

Fairness contract shape & waiver mechani.question: How should a per-mode override declare its WaiverReason?

Fairness contract shape & waiver mechani.question: How should FAIR-02's 30-day deprecation-calendar gate work mechanically?
Fairness contract shape & waiver mechani.answer: Static deprecation calendar via `deprecation_at: YYYY-MM-DD` field on each (provider, model_id) row of bench/datasets/cost-table.yaml. FAIR-02 gate fires when `deprecation_at - today < 30d`. No live provider-API call — keeps runs reproducible from `--run-id`. Staleness bounded by the existing 90-day cost-table `valid_until` / `last_verified` rotation.
options_presented: Static calendar in cost-table.yaml deprecation_at field
Live provider-API check at run start

Fairness contract shape & waiver mechani.question: How should FAIR-03's 5% between-run variance warning be wired?
Fairness contract shape & waiver mechani.answer: Per-task gate: across N≥3 runs of the same (task, mode), flag when `(max(tokens_input) - min(tokens_input)) / mean(tokens_input) > 0.05`. Cached-input fields (`tokens_input_cached_read`, `tokens_input_cache_write`) reported as separate columns so cache-hit-rate variance is visible alongside. Warning flows to cost_quality.md.
